place: rooftop scaffold above a hazy city, daytime
shows: All six stand in a line on a wooden rooftop deck and bounce, chopping hands and pointing fists at the lens; Bottle holds a lunch pail low.
faults: triangles small and hard to read on some masks (Plum, Marine); otherwise none seen

place: worm's-eye view between buildings, blue sky, airship overhead
shows: Camera looks straight up at the six standing in a ring over it, jabbing fingers and fists down at the lens; Marine holds binoculars, an airship passes behind.
faults: Marine's triangle sits near centre-left of the ring; Plum's mask partly turned away; hands blur

place: marble bank hall with teller counters
shows: The six bounce in the middle of a grand banking hall, Crimson crouched in front pointing at the lens, while an unmasked clerk at the counter reads papers.
faults: around 4 s the masks morph (rings and triangles smear, heads bow and lose shape); an unmasked clerk in the background

place: snowy field at night, vintage cars with headlights
shows: The six in a diagonal line in falling snow punch fists up and down, Silver nearest pointing at the lens, two old cars glowing behind.
faults: Marine and Bottle show no visible triangle; far men small

place: meadow at dawn in front of a hot-air balloon
shows: The six pose in two rows before an inflating balloon, Plum crouched front throwing his arms wide, the back row waving hands; an unmasked ground crewman hammers a stake on the right.
faults: back-row masks read as dark faces with no clear triangle (Crimson, Marine, Silver look face-like); unmasked crewman in shot

place: wood-panelled train dining car, countryside outside
shows: The six bounce down the aisle of a luxury dining car, Marine and Silver up front chopping and pointing at the lens; an unmasked white-jacketed steward stands at the back.
faults: back men overlap and swap places a little; unmasked steward behind; otherwise none seen

place: bank steps and columns, fire in the doorway, dusk
shows: The six pose on the bank steps with flames behind and banknotes raining, Crimson crouched front pointing and pushing a palm at the lens.
faults: triangles mostly unreadable at this size; Plum's mask inner goes dark; otherwise none seen

place: busy night street under theatre marquees
shows: Five crouch and bounce in the road with a crowd clapping on the pavements and money falling, Rust sitting up on a cream roadster's bonnet waving.
faults: marquee lettering is mushy fake text; triangles unreadable at this size

place: wet cobbled street at night under a theatre marquee
shows: Plum crouches close to the lens jabbing his finger, the other five bounce and point behind him, Bottle at the back holding an umbrella.

place: wet cobbled street at night under a theatre marquee
shows: Plum and Silver close at the front pointing and punching at the lens, Crimson, Marine and Rust bouncing behind, Bottle at the back under an umbrella.
faults: wrong wardrobe: Plum in a black overcoat and Silver in a brown tweed overcoat instead of their suits; Silver's triangle sits centre-low; Marine shows no triangle

place: tenement rooftop under a water tower, morning
shows: Five cluster at the lens pointing and punching up while Rust snaps his pocket watch shut and strides in to join them.
faults: Rust's mask shows a dark eye-like hole in the ring around 2 s; Silver's triangle near centre; Plum's mask goes blurry close to lens

place: bank steps with columns, explosion behind, dusk
shows: All six walk calmly down the bank steps toward camera in a line as a fireball rises and fades to smoke behind them; paper flutters and Plum's handful burns.
faults: triangles unreadable at this distance; Marine shows only a ring
